summary: Iteration 4 — ATS Resume Builder v2 fully validated. BACKEND: new /app/backend/tests/test_resume_builder_v2.py — 18/18 PASSED in 23s against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covered: (A) /career/resumes/extract — valid messy finance resume returns sections including WORK EXPERIENCE, missing_fields contains 'Phone' (auto-added when absent), consumes exactly +1 resume_generation; <150 chars → 400; grocery-list text → 422 and did NOT consume usage. (B) Manual POST with template='modern' and sections having content+hint — hints persisted on resume; PUT updates template to 'compact' + missing_fields list ['Projects','Certifications'] — all persisted. (C) Downloads: PDF (%PDF, >800B) and DOCX (PK, >800B) for a resume with a HIDDEN hint token 'SAMPLE_HINT_TOKEN_SHOULD_NEVER_LEAK' and leak markers 'LEAK_PDF_DO_NOT_INCLUDE' / 'LEAK_PDF_EMPTY_SECTION'; extracted text via pypdf + python-docx asserted that neither the hint token nor leak markers appear anywhere, and the empty SKILLS section is excluded (only SUMMARY + EDUCATION rendered). (D) All three templates classic/modern/compact render valid PDF + DOCX files >800B with correct magic bytes. (E) Access control on manual create: fresh candidate consented → tools.resume_builder.enabled=false → 403 on POST /career/resumes; and free_access=false → 403; both restored. Final verification that admin settings match defaults (free 2/2/1, quarterly 10, half 15, annual 25, all tools enabled & free_access true, period_days=30). (F) tailor returns ai_tailor resume with notes[] list and preserves template='modern' from source; duplicate also preserves template. (G) regression: /api/plans returns 599 / 799 / 999 for 90/180/365 days; analyser and interview validation 400s still work. Also updated prior test_career.py from 499/699/999 → 599/799/999 to match current config. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, candidate test@jobradar.com): /career/resume-builder shows two large TypeCards (Fresher 'Create Fresher Resume' + Experienced 'Create Experienced Resume'); clicking Fresher reveals 3 cards (rb-template-general/it/finance) each with ATS-friendly single-column SAMPLE preview showing 'SAMPLE — placeholder content' badge; selecting 'IT / Technical Fresher' and tapping 'Use This Template' navigates to /career/resume/{id} editor with empty section inputs showing hint placeholders (no sample data saved), contact prefilled only from user profile (email+phone). Editor exposed all testIDs: re-save, re-download, re-preview, re-add-section, re-add-experience, re-tailor-open, re-duplicate, re-style-classic/modern/compact; template chips switch styles. Download sheet opens with Download PDF + Download Word (DOCX) + Cancel buttons. Preview modal re-paper renders only filled sections (shows 'Your sections are empty' message when none filled). Experienced flow: rb-type-experienced-btn opens paste box with correct placeholder 'Copy your current resume from Word, PDF text or another document and paste it here...', UsagePill '2 of 10 AI resume generations left · resets every 30 days', pasting <150 chars triggers toast 'Please paste your complete resume text', rb-exp-blank navigates to editor with 15 default sections; Save Resume works (button becomes 'Saved ✓'); Add Work Experience inserts a new section. Reopen flow from /career/history → Resumes tab shows list, tapping a card routes to the correct /career/resume/{id}. Missing-details card (re-missing) renders for the extracted resume with each missing_fields entry and a ✕ to dismiss. Customise My Resume for a Job (re-tailor-open → re-tailor-jd + re-tailor-submit) opens correctly. AI budget this iteration: 1 extract + 1 tailor (via backend tests). Pre-existing legacy 'Improved — …' resumes carried over from Iter-3 (ai_improve) have template=None in storage but that is NOT in scope for this iteration (only ai_builder/ai_extract/ai_tailor + manual).

critical_code_review_comments: career.py is now 983 lines — still above the 700-line split threshold flagged in iter-3. Recommend splitting into career/{resumes,extract,analyser,interview,admin}.py when there is bandwidth.

extract_resume correctly re-uses the resume_generation Lock + record_usage pattern and raises 422 BEFORE record_usage so a 'not a resume' response does not consume quota — verified by test_extract_grocery_returns_422_and_no_usage.

export_sections() filters by `(s.get('content') or '').strip()` which correctly excludes empty guidance sections; hints are never surfaced to render_pdf/render_docx — verified by extracting PDF/DOCX text.

ResumeBody now accepts template + missing_fields; good. However the manual POST /career/resumes also goes through require_tool('resume_builder', ai=False) which gates on tool.enabled + tool.free_access + membership — confirmed working (403 both cases).
duplicate_resume and tailor_resume both carry over d.get('template','classic') — verified by tests.
